tokens.note: ἀφιέτω en=divorce. Context: "let him not divorce/send away his wife." ἀφίημι = release/let go. 赦す (forgive) ≠ divorce/send away.
ἀφίησιν en=leaves. "The hired hand leaves the sheep and flees." ἀφίημι = abandon/leave behind. 赦す ≠ leaves.
ἀφῆκεν en=let. "He would not have let his house be broken into." ἀφίημι = permit/allow. 赦す ≠ let/permit.
Ἄφες en=let. "Let the dead bury their own dead." ἄφες = let/allow. 赦す ≠ let.
Ἄφετε en=let. "Let the little children come to me." ἄφετε = let/allow/do not hinder. 赦す ≠ let come.
ἀφήκατε en=neglected. "You have neglected the weightier matters of the law." ἀφίημι = left aside/neglected. 赦す ≠ neglected.
tokens.revisedCandidate: 疎かにする・後回しにする

tokens.note: ἀφίεται en=left. "One will be taken and one will be left [behind]." Eschatological left-behind sense. 赦す ≠ left behind.
tokens.revisedCandidate: 残される・置き去りにされる

tokens.note: Ἄφες en=let it be. "Permit it to be so now." ἄφες = let/allow/permit. 赦す ≠ let it be.
tokens.revisedCandidate: 許す・そうさせなさい

tokens.note: Ἄφες en=let. "Let me take the speck out of your eye." ἄφες = let/allow. 赦す ≠ let me.
tokens.revisedCandidate: 許す・させてください

tokens.note: ἀφεὶς en=left. "Leaving them, he got into the boat." ἀφεὶς = having left/departed from. 赦す ≠ leaving.
ἀφεῖς en=tolerate. "You tolerate that woman Jezebel." ἀφίημι = permit/allow/tolerate. 赦す ≠ tolerate.
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=must. "This perishable must put on the imperishable." Impersonal necessity δεῖ. 縛る (bind) does not convey "must/is necessary."
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=must. "He must also have a good reputation with outsiders." δεῖ of necessary qualification. 縛る ≠ must.
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=necessary. "It is necessary to circumcise them." Impersonal δεῖ. 縛る ≠ necessary.
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=necessary. "It is necessary for one of these men to become a witness." Impersonal δεῖ. 縛る ≠ necessary.
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=ought. "Where I ought to be tried." Obligatory sense. 縛る ≠ ought.
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=must. "I must bring them also." Divine necessity. 縛る ≠ must.
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=ought. "The place where we ought to worship." Obligatory sense. 縛る ≠ ought.
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=must. "I must proclaim the good news." Divine necessity. 縛る ≠ must.
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=must. "Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?" Prophetic necessity. 縛る ≠ must.
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=ought. "We do not know what we ought to pray for." Guidance-necessity. 縛る ≠ ought.
ἔκρινά en=decided. "I decided to know nothing among you except Christ." κρίνω = determined/resolved (personal decision). 裁く (judicial judgment) does not represent "decided."
κεκρίκει en=decided. "Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus." κεκρίκει = had determined/decided. 裁く ≠ decided (travel decision).
